crossModalityDiagnosis: At current committed-artifact coverage NO modality can honestly be called data-limited vs model-limited from a dev curve alone: the binding constraint everywhere is prediction coverage over the grown label sets (Mac-only pipeline stages). The two decidable facts are (a) ownership's error mass is slice-concentrated (edge-on), i.e. domain-shaped, and (b) contact shows a dev→held-out shift signature in already-committed rows. Concrete next measurement: one Mac session running lab:regen + the paddle/stroke/event benches over the 34-event / 28-contact / 22-stroke label sets would convert all four curves from 2-3 points to 4+ session groups without a single new label.
